title: Barra Brava
desc: Shot over the course of one intense week in Cali, Colombia, ‘Barra Brava’ that offers a vérité-style immersion into the world of South America’s most passionate and controversial football supporters, specifically the Barón Rojo Sur barra brava. The film lets the members speak for themselves, captured entirely on 16mm film and underscored by an original synth score.
